prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE finished Korean StepUp mobile app screen, portrait 887x1774 (1:2 ratio). Flat full-screen UI, no handset, no board, no title outside screen.
REFERENCE ROLES: image1 is an established StepUp screen in the APPROVED NEW blue style, use its palette, typography, logo scale and component finish, not its page content. Image2 is the exact original transparent logo. If image3 exists, it is an older content/layout reference only; restyle it to match image1.
VISUAL SYSTEM: #031427 midnight navy background, #0B2B50 blue inset panels, #0754FF filled electric cobalt emphasis, #48D9FA restrained cyan highlights, #F5F8FF white primary surfaces, #AAC3EA secondary copy. Crisp sporty game-inspired finish, adult clarity and simple big buttons. Subtle material depth and shallow blue button underside; NO orange/yellow CTA, no decorative emoji, trophies, characters, creatures, random HUD shapes or particle fields. No shoe stage on functional running screens. One strong focal element, calm surrounding UI, 20px phone-equivalent gutters, at least 52px tappable primary control. Korean Pretendard-like sans, readable title/body; condensed italic only for big athletic numerals, never body paragraphs.
Original logo must preserve exact white STEP + royal-blue UP with upward arrow integrated into U, no changes to spelling, symbol or proportions. Secondary screens use small back arrow and compact logo at top, page title below; do not waste height on giant logo. NO bottom five-tab navigation on focused running/setup/detail/modal screens unless explicitly requested. A modest home indicator is fine.
Primary action is wide ICE-WHITE with dark navy bold text and narrow cobalt underside matching reference 1. Secondary action is navy with a subtle blue edge. Destructive actions use restrained red only where needed. Disabled controls muted and clearly inactive. Keep all buttons separate and readable.
Maps are quiet top-down dark navy cartography with blue rivers and gray-blue roads, subtle actual-map-like details. Routes on LAND beside the Han river, no crossing water without a bridge, blue current-position dot if relevant. For mock maps include tiny '지도 예시'. This is a design preview, not live GPS. Do not render scenic photographs, a shoe showroom or a fantasy map in place of navigation.
All numbers are example mock data. Korean text must be correct and legible. Do not invent additional product functions, reward payouts or claims. No explanatory annotations outside the UI.

CRITICAL: SUP balance is permitted ONLY on HOME and U01 menu. On EVERY other screen leave the header's right side clear unless a specified contextual action exists. Do not copy SUP from the style reference. Use exact requested headings. No extra decorative actions.

ALL bottom sheets and dialogs use MIDNIGHT NAVY surfaces with white text. Never white modal background. Preserve functional hierarchy; render a single clear state. Do not show internal screen IDs.

SCREEN CR19
CREW SWITCH sheet fromcrewentry. 내 크루 선택. Three distinct large selectable rowswithsimpleownemblems:여의도 퇴근런/크루원30명 selected,한강 새벽런/크루원18명,주말 한 바퀴/크루원12명. White선택한 크루로 보기. Xcancel, no compulsoryreselectionon everyentry.
